overview:
## mockAskpass injection hardening — Difficulty: 3/5

This PR closes a shell/JSON-injection footgun in the test-SDK helper `mockAskpass()` (`./testing` subpath), pre-existing since 0.7.0. The old implementation interpolated caller-supplied `reason`/`by`/`decidedAt` raw into a JSON body emitted from an *unquoted* heredoc, so a `"` could break the JSON or forge sibling fields and a `$(...)`/backtick/newline would be shell-interpreted and executed when the generated script ran as `$HOOK_KIT_ASKPASS`. The fix builds the response object in TypeScript, `JSON.stringify`s it, emits it as a single-quoted shell string (rendering `$`, backtick, `\` and newline inert), and splices the request id in via a high-entropy sentinel + POSIX parameter expansion + `printf` instead of `sed`. A 284-line regression suite drives hostile reason/by/decidedAt/id values through both the raw script and the production `callAskpass`/Zod path, asserting exact round-trip and that no sentinel command file is created.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A["mockAskpass(response)"] --> B["JSON.stringify({ id: sentinel, decision, reason?, by, decidedAt })"]
  B --> C["escapeForSingleQuotes(json)"]
  C --> D["emit script: RESPONSE='...single-quoted...'"]
  D --> E["script reads REQ from stdin"]
  E --> F["ID = grep -oE id from REQ"]
  F --> G{"RESPONSE contains sentinel?"}
  G -->|"yes"| H["PRE=RESPONSE before sentinel; POST=after"]
  H --> I["printf '%s%s%s' PRE ID POST -> valid JSON"]
  I --> J["callAskpass parses via Zod, checks response.id == request.id"]
  class A,B,C,D,F,H,I chg
```

Riskiest area to watch: the sentinel-splice contract — a real `reason`/`by`/`decidedAt` value containing the literal sentinel substring, or a degenerate request id, must still split cleanly and emit valid JSON; verify `printf '%s%s%s'` and the `grep`/empty-id path hold for all field values.
